title: Grateful Dead Live at Fillmore West on 1968-08-21
lineage: Dat (Sony PCM-R500) > Tascam DA-3000 > wav 16/44; Edited & Mastered in Audacity by Joe Noel: Wave > Flac 16/44; Checksum & tags created in xACT; the original version of this source was off pitch; please don't circulate that version
source: SBD > Master Reels > Dat; Charlie Miller

ai_review.summary: Crystal‑clear soundboard capture of a high‑energy ’68 show with a monster Alligator and smoking St. Stephen/The Eleven sequence, marred only by a brief diginoise glitch.
ai_review.review: The Miller/Noel master delivers an exceptionally clean and balanced soundboard recording that lets the band’s 1968 vigor shine through – from the towering Alligator to the precise St. Stephen and the searing The Eleven. Reviewers rave about the snare intro on The Eleven and Jerry’s short‑lived Les Paul tone, though a one‑second diginoise artifact around Alligator and slight early‑set balance quirks are noted.

ai_rating.rationale: Show performance is consistently praised (high energy, standout jams) and recording is mostly excellent; a single notable defect lowers the overall average slightly.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Clear, clean, and well‑balanced with crisp snare detail on The Eleven; minor issues include a ~1 s diginoise glitch at Alligator (16:41) and slightly off balance early in the set.

show_quality.setlist_flow: First set builds with a peak Alligator and jammed Cryptical fragment; second set opens with a rare Dark Star>St. Stephen>Eleven sequence that smokes, followed by tight Death Don't and classic ’68 material.

band_member_comments.Jerry: His short‑lived Les Paul tone is highlighted as nice; guitar work generally praised.
band_member_comments.Drums: Snare drum intro on The Eleven noted; a middle jam featuring Garcia and drums receives special mention.
